method.boundary: Noul receives shared state, own instructions and own two binary descriptions. Choice/Score receives shared state, own instructions and exactly one candidate description; Choice also receives that candidate name. Other question and candidate criteria are absent.
method.review: Read all four states and the common question map for each of the forty families; verified question maps are identical within family. Findings are determined by raw request semantics, not prediction accuracy.
method.prior_exposure: The initial rubric concern arose during post-selection Jev error analysis. This expanded audit is not blinded to those earlier observations, but exhaustively includes correct and incorrect outcomes alike; prediction files were not loaded in constructing or selecting this audit inventory.
method.classification_rule: Confirm missing authored premises only when an isolated judgment depends on a custom band threshold, trigger, or temporal scope supplied solely elsewhere. Do not equate ordinary-language labels, intentional unknown evidence, or ordinary lexical ambiguity with a missing custom rule.
method.changes: No frozen file, label, relation, question, selection, or model changed. Proposed states are artifacts only.

category_review.assessment: Named authors, required evidence, and procedural stages are supplied in each state/instruction/criterion. One ambiguous "None of those" candidate is recorded separately; no confirmed missing arbitrary rule.

Authorization and execution predicates and workflow criteria use meanings supplied directly in the leaf or state. The crew-staging wording caveat is already in the relevant unit, not a missing cross-question premise.

Unknown/failed/attempted distinctions are explicit in the pertinent binary criteria, state rules, or candidate definitions. Ordinary completed/failed terms do not require importing other candidate labels.

Speaker roles and adopted/provisional/formal positions are described in state and own leaf criteria. Tentative endorsement may warrant linguistic interpretation but supplies no absent custom numeric rule.
Entity mappings and tested/inspected/awarded status definitions are visible in state and own criteria; counts of one/both are ordinary meanings with the two entities present.
Actor/action evidence and operational stages are explicit in state/own criteria. Pronouns refer to the single action or object already present in the state.

Most named times and periods appear in the question or state. The freezer family loses the exact evening window for v2/v3 Choice and Score leaves. Its n1 already includes the full bounds; n2 asks the explicit time 13:30 and does not need a copied window to resolve that timestamp.
Chronology, last-event authority, queued versus executed commands, and lifecycle levels are explicit or ordinary event meanings within each unit. No sibling-only custom rule found.

The unit supplies its universe/scope evidence or explicit numeric count criterion. Quantifiers all/none/at-least-one do not need a borrowed rubric. Incomplete scope is intentional evidence, not a missing authored rule.

All 32 band-named binary judgments omit custom thresholds. The severity family additionally has cross-candidate higher-trigger dependencies in its three lower Choice and Score candidates. Other families use self-contained disjoint numeric ranges in their Choice/Score candidates.
